payload.release_notes:
- Refined the dashboard, file menus, Connected PCs, Settings, and Nest controls, including clearer button states and the official LUMA logo.
- Nest opens with the full roll fitted on screen, Layout options expanded, and artwork visible in every section. Zoom and Preview only are available for closer inspection.
- Fixed file menu actions during refresh, stale selection counts across tabs, and Resume after Stop. Nest validates roll stock for the material you choose.
